CURRENT QUEST

PILGRIM'S JOURNAL

⌨ Move: arrows / WASD   Interact: Space / Enter / A   Answer: 1–3 or tap   Truth Journal: J   Map menu: M. Follow the city road east to the fields, then meet those pursuing Christian outside the walls. In Map 3 return from Sinai to the EAST road. In Map 4 cross the castle road, read the inscription, and knock three times. In Map 5, move EAST through three galleries of the Interpreter’s House. In Map 7, climb NORTH, and return SOUTH when the sealed roll is missing. In Map 8, heed Watchful, speak with the palace household, and receive the armor. In Map 9: X / K / B = sword; hold SHIFT = shield. On iPhone use SWORD and hold SHIELD.

Inspired by John Bunyan's The Pilgrim's Progress (1678). Version 13: all nine maps have enhanced original 16-bit pixel art; gameplay and chapter progression remain the same. Dialogue is an educational adaptation of Bunyan, not a verbatim transcript; playable hazards and dialogue choices are original additions. Sound choices do not force another character to believe. Your progress saves on this device when browser storage is available. Story Mode contains no skip-ahead previews.
